text:
Ivy (AE): Harper asked for a final POC acceptance doc today. Key asks: p95 latency target, cost cap per 1M reqs, and quality parity. We need owners for each gate.

Samir (SE): ok. need traffic profile and the golden prompt set to size batching and pick model/quantization. Also: what counts as a request-equivalent (tokenization rules)?

Harper (Customer): traffic estimate: sustained 18 qps, peaks to 65 qps (minutes-long), avg input 130 tokens, avg output 90, monthly ~900k request-equivalents. We'll share golden prompts (200 examples).

Jo (Eng): recommend hosted canary first (24-48h) with identical replay, then spin dedicated 1-node pool if canary passes. Quantized fp8/8-bit runs as sensitivity. We'll propose automatic fallback to baseline model on gate fail.

Samir (SE): proposed acceptance gates: 
- Performance gate: p95 <= 260ms over 48h canary, error rate <0.5%, no sustained throttling.
- Cost gate: modeled burn <= $325 per 1M req-equivalents (we'll show tokenization math + hosted vs dedicated scenarios).
- Quality gate: golden-set metrics: BLEU/ROUGE-L relative drop <=1.0% and Top-1 accuracy within 0.02 of baseline. If quantized variant used, must meet same thresholds.

Ivy (AE): security/compliance gate: KMS (customer CMK ok), SSO (SAML), and audit logs retention 90 days. sec-bot please attach SOC2 excerpt and KMS wiring.

sec-bot: attached: soc2-summary.pdf, kms-wiring.txt :white_check_mark:

Jo (Eng): perf test plan to run (short):
```
profile: mixed
sustained_qps: 18
peak_qps: 65
p50_seq_len: 150
p95_seq_len: 720
duration: 3h
metrics: p50,p95,p99,error_rate,token_burn
```
Primary gate uses p95. We'll run fp16 and 8-bit runs to compare.

Samir (SE): rollback protocol: if p95 > threshold for 10 continuous minutes OR error_rate >0.5% for 5 minutes -> automated traffic shift to baseline model, page oncall (Jo -> Samir -> Ivy). MTTR target 30m. Runbook snippet will be in the acceptance doc.

Harper (Customer): for cost gate, show both committed-dedicated and hosted payg scenarios and sensitivity to batching window. Also include data handling appendix for RAG content in sandbox.

Ivy (AE): action items / timeline:
- Today EOD: Samir uploads golden-set and run harness.
- +24h: Jo posts perf results (p95 + token burn + quantized comparison).
- +36h: Jo posts cost scenarios for hosted vs dedicated.
- +48-72h: final acceptance doc sent to Harper and sign-off meeting scheduled.
Owners: Samir (golden-set & run), Jo (perf runs & cost), Ivy (acceptance doc & customer comms).

Jo (Eng): note on quantization: 8-bit gives ~1.5x throughput typically but watch for small quality regressions on adversarial prompts. We'll flag any golden-set examples that regress >1%.

Ivy (AE): thanks team — I'll compile the acceptance doc once assets in and book a 30-min sign-off with Harper. :thumbsup:
